edits.new:
### 12. Contract

This story owns no screen. The empty, loading, error and no-access states of SCR-30 and SCR-31 are Not specified in the source documents for this story (DOR-RWB-P6-E1032-APP-10).

HTTP 404 is returned for an unknown notice, and also for a request for an intake item, a match status or a review decision, which this service does not serve (X11). HTTP 409 is returned when the case or the template is not in a state that allows generation. The message ID of each error is Not specified in the source documents (DOR-RWB-P6-E1032-APP-8).

Open decision DL10 is still open. Its assumptions are ASM-2250, ASM-2357, ASM-2377 and ASM-2863, and this story relies on them until DL10 is closed.

edits.old: Field IDs are those of the Logical Data Model and Data Dictionary.
edits.new:
Field IDs are those of the Logical Data Model and Data Dictionary.

Personal data: the notice `party_id` (DF-LEG-030) and the recipient name and postal address that the copy merges from P1 are personal data. The `notice` row holds the party ID and no name or address.

edits.old: The seventeen IDs, their order and their legacy data are kept.
edits.new: The seventeen IDs, their order and their legacy data are kept. TC-E1-032-18 (contract) and TC-E1-032-19 (table boundary) and TC-E1-032-20 to TC-E1-032-29 (one case for each rule BR1 to BR10) are added by this story and have no legacy ID.

edits.old: | TC-E1-032-15 | AC3 | Component | Two requests for one notice with different idempotency keys; one notice, one copy, one event and no second handoff |
edits.new:
| TC-E1-032-15 | AC3 | Component | Two requests for one notice with different idempotency keys; one notice, one copy, one event and no second handoff |
| TC-E1-032-18 | Section 12 contract | Component | Every operation, event and activity of section 12 is checked against the P6 contract; a call or event outside section 12 fails |
| TC-E1-032-19 | Section 12.7 tables (ASM-3438) | Component | A statement naming a table not listed in section 12.7 is refused; rwb-comms writes only the tables marked Written and reads only the tables marked Read |
| TC-E1-032-20 | BR1 | Component | Letter copy requested from a template version that is withdrawn or not approved by Legal; generation is held and no copy is made |
| TC-E1-032-21 | BR2 | Component | A template merge code with an empty required value; the notice is held and no blank is printed |
| TC-E1-032-22 | BR3 | Component | Letter copy handed to the hub with source GENERATED; the notice stores the document ID the hub returns |
| TC-E1-032-23 | BR4 | Component | A write to document_intake, document or document_text, or a read of a P5 table, is refused |
| TC-E1-032-24 | BR5 | Component | Decision record written before the copy is claimed as stored; a record that cannot be written rolls the transaction back |
| TC-E1-032-25 | BR6 | Component | NoticeGenerated is written to the outbox in the same transaction as the notice row, keyed by the case ID, with IDs and facts only |
| TC-E1-032-26 | BR7 | Component | The same Idempotency-Key returns the first notice; one copy and one event |
| TC-E1-032-27 | BR8 | Component | A notice read without the Litigation read right or outside scope is refused and no copy content is returned |
| TC-E1-032-28 | BR9 | Component | Notice type, language, product group and channel are read as LOV values through the P3 reference-data contract; no code list is written in code |
| TC-E1-032-29 | BR10 | Component | A consumed call with a 2 s timeout and a breaker; a hub that refuses or is late leaves no notice that points at a copy the hub does not hold |
